# Gwylio reference for the analyst skill

Every closed value and identifier the analyst skill may write into a submission, and every verb of the `gwylio` command line tool. Values outside these lists are not valid in a submission. Regenerate with `make schema` after changing configuration.

## Command line verbs

| Verb | What it does |
|---|---|
| `gwylio check` | Validate every configuration file and print a summary per file. |
| `gwylio schema` | Generate JSON Schema, TypeScript types, the glossary and the skill reference. |
| `gwylio version` | Print the package version. |

## Scanability

How far public, indexed sources can see a requirement at all.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `high` | Public sources see the drivers and the evidence well. |
| `medium` | Public sources see the drivers, but the evidence only at release. |
| `low` | Evidence is mostly internal; public sources see it only in known windows. |
| `none` | Evidence is wholly internal; no public source will ever report on it. |

## Coverage status

Computed, never written by hand. A blind spot is never rendered as quiet.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `covered` | Three or more active reports. |
| `thin` | One or two active reports. |
| `quiet` | No active reports, and public sources could see movement if there were any. |
| `blind_spot` | No active reports, and public sources cannot see this requirement: absence is not evidence, so never call it quiet. |

## Lenses and lanes

Lanes say where a signal was found; requirements say what it means.

|---|---|---|---|
| `welsh-government` | Welsh Government | `government` | Welsh Government policy, legislation, consultations, statistics and the remit letter to Natural Resources Wales (NRW). |
| `senedd` | Senedd | `government` | Senedd Cymru business: committee inquiries and reports, plenary questions, Bills and research briefings. |
| `uk-government-and-regulators` | UK Government and regulators | `government` | UK Government departments, UK-wide regulators and advisory bodies whose decisions reach Wales. |
| `research-evidence` | Research and evidence | `partnership_society` | Peer-reviewed research, research councils and evidence centres publishing findings relevant to the Welsh environment. |
| `partnership-and-civil-society` | Partnership and civil society | `partnership_society` | Partners, farming unions, environmental charities, public services boards and utilities working with or alongside NRW. |

| `ecological-surveillance` | Ecological surveillance | `government` | Statutory and scientific surveillance schemes that give early warning of disease, invasive species, drought and other biophysical change. |
| `international` | International | `international` | United Nations, European Union and other international bodies, conventions and Conferences of the Parties (COPs) whose approaches bear on Wales. |
| `governance-capacity` | Governance and capacity | `government` | Audit, scrutiny and watchdog bodies reporting on the funding, governance and delivery capacity of Welsh public bodies. |
